title: Tooling: 69× faster mixed-point Circuit.verify supports with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, merged [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1984](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1984) sped up mixed-point `scalar_check` digests but left the general `Circuit.verify` path on `scripts/experiments/mixed_point_circuit.py` on the historical set-intersection genexpr

```text
sum(1<<i for i,source in enumerate(inputs) if len(set(source)&set(target))==r)
```

Profiling on `build(30,3,3,1)` shows that genexpr dominates `Circuit.verify` wall time. This PR replaces it with an equivalent closed-form point-incidence mask: precompute `vertex[p]`, then for each r-subset `U` of the target keep inputs that contain every point of `U` and avoid every other target point. Every output support still matches the historical checker, `verify` still returns `True`, and support admission uses `require` so it stays enforced under `-O`. Only the source pin for `scripts/experiments/mixed_point_circuit.py` changes inside the two certificates that bind that file.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 (Linux-6.12.94+-x86_64-with-glibc2.39), five alternating fresh-process pairs timing only `Circuit.verify` on the fixed fixture set `build(20,3,3,{0,1})`, `build(26,3,3,{0,1})`, `build(30,3,3,1)` (construction excluded) gave median wall time **8.331 → 0.121 seconds (69.03×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Every verify receipt matches the baseline checker (`True` return and identical output-support fingerprints).

Package: `research/mixed-point-verify-masks/`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/mixed-point-verify-masks/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/mixed-point-verify-masks/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/mixed-point-verify-masks
python3.12 -I -B research/mixed-point-verify-masks/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_MIXED_POINT_VERIFY_MASKS verify_cases=11 mask_cases=3994 certs=2 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/mixed-point-verify-masks outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_MIXED_POINT_VERIFY_MASK_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Mask nonequivalence mutant, corrupted-support `ValueError`, and temp-copy digest corruption controls reject. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different objects or delivery): [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), merged [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1984](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1984) (`scalar_check` digests on the same file; this only rewrites general `Circuit.verify`), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2001](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2001) (ExclusionCircuit / DisjointTensor support masks; same style, different file/relation), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1861](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1861) (open; same `parity-side.json`, different pin keys), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2117](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2117) (open; same `parity-side.json`, different pin key `disjoint_tensor.py`). No competing open PR on mixed-point `Circuit.verify` at refresh.

Douglas R. Colkitt authored the mixed-point circuit. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
